configurePresets.name: linux-gcc-debug
configurePresets.description: Configure using GCC in Debug mode on remote Linux

configurePresets.name: linux-gcc-debug-board
configurePresets.displayName: Linux GCC Debug (FPGA board, local OpenSSL)
configurePresets.description: Non-Docker build on the FPGA board against a hand-built OpenSSL 3.6.1 in /usr/local. OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR is set in the environment (not just as a cache var) so it propagates to the nested cFS arch sub-build.

configurePresets.name: linux-gcc-debug-tests
configurePresets.description: Same as linux-gcc-debug but with ENABLE_UNIT_TESTS=true so the UT-Assert coverage testrunners (e.g. apps/apqs_app/unit-test) are built. Run the tests with ctest (test preset of the same name).
